title: Indirect immunofluorescence with preextraction \(in situ cell fractionation)
protocol: Plate 15-20x10^3 cells on coverslips 1 day before staining.
Wash cells with ice-cold PBS twice gently.
Treat cells with ice-cold cytoskeleton buffer for 5 minutes on ice.
Aspirate and add an ice-cold cytoskeleton stripping buffer for 5 minutes on ice.
Wash cells with ice-cold PBS three times.
Fix cells in fixative for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Permeabilize cells for 15 minutes at room temperature with permeabilization buffer.
Wash cells with PBS three times.
Block cells for 30 minutes with PBG 1X.
Stain cells with primary antibody diluted in PBG 1X for 1 hour at room temperature.
Wash cells gently with PBG 1X five times three times.
Stain cells with secondary antibody diluted in PBG 1X for 1 hour at room temperature.
Wash cells gently twice with PBG 1X and twice with PBS, each for five minutes.
Stain cells with Dapi for 5 minutes in the dark.
Mount coverslips with 3 μl of Mowiol mounting medium.
Let coverslips dry before microscope analysis.
